$comment: In-vitro test fixture for the Snapmaker U1 adapter. The adapter OWNS its fake device: this file plus `skeleton/` (a verbatim seed tree) plus ../jinni/paths.json fully define the device the generic runner stands up; the harness and test specs know nothing U1-specific. Placeholders ($BESPOK3D, $KLIPPER_EXTRAS, ...) resolve against paths.json so paths are declared once. `skeleton.dirs`/`skeleton.files` are for empty dirs and tiny inline content; `skeleton.seed` names a directory mirroring the device root, docker-cp'd in verbatim, for real captured files (boot scripts, factory configs). The seed files here were captured 2026-06-27 from the real CI/CD bot 'junior' (unU1jr) on GENUINE stock firmware 1.4.1.6_20260608141446, as a PRE-ENROLL image (the virgin capture in `related material/u1-virgin-1.4.1/`): printer.cfg/moonraker.conf carry no bespok3d includes, S90lmd/nginx carry no bespok3d hooks (the enroll steps add those), and the box is genuinely stock (no /usr/local/bin/extended-config.py, no [include extended/...]) so no sanitization was needed. Treat any in-vitro/on-device divergence as a bug in this fixture; re-seed from the bot's virgin capture after a firmware bump.
